binaryFactor strips trailing zero bits and distinguishes normal/subnormal exponent offsets. Reviewed full-width multiplication carry, signed accumulation/subtraction, guard/sticky nearest-even rounding, and accumulator sizing; no concrete defect identified by inspection.
